[D1:14] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a table with a bunch of books on it
[D1:15] John: That's great! Loving it when people are passionate about their work. What kind of collaborations are you involved in for the fan project? I love talking to people about my sneaker collection.
[D1:15] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a circle of shoes on the floor in a room
[D1:16] Tim: Thanks! We'll be discussing various aspects of the Harry Potter universe, like characters, spells, and magical creatures. It's great to see fans coming together for this.
[D1:17] John: Wow! Have you been to any places related to it?
[D1:17] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a bookcase filled with books and toys
[D1:18] Tim: I went to a place in London a few years ago - it was like walking into a Harry Potter movie! I also went on a tour which was amazing. Have you been to any of the real Potter places? I'd love to explore them someday!

[D24:12] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a man sitting on a chair with a blue ball

[D24:14] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a treadmill in a room with a window
[D24:15] Tim: Wow! How was it jogging without any discomfort?
